versions.changelog: Copied the published 1; Deleted keychainGet; Added a strict per-command --top range (out-of-range values are rejected); The relay must now be a literal loopback IP; TOKEN_FILE is no longer in OWNED_FILES; reserve() and bumpActivity() now run under an O_EXCL lock file (linkedin-activity; Those passages now say API calls are an in-tab fetch() and search people navigates the tab to a LinkedIn searc
Twin of linkedin-hack 1.2.1: cookie extract/store/replay deleted; exact origin pin.

Initial ClawHub release. Crawls LinkedIn through the browser session you already have — profiles, search, connections, inbox, feed. The session cookie is sealed in your OS keychain, sending a message requires an explicit flag, and 'session logout' erases everything.
